hero.title: I started on Roblox in 2022 out of curiosity.
hero.lead: Today I have six published games, a Roblox group with 130 members and a half-built voxel engine of my own. I write almost everything in Luau; the rest, in GDScript and C++.

about.title: About me
about.note: Who I am, how I started and what I'm up to now.
about.intro: My name is Anthony. I learned Luau by breaking things in Roblox Studio until my first game came out, and I haven't stopped since.
about.p1: In 2023 I founded Multi Game Inc, the group I publish everything under. Today we're 130 members, with six published games and close to 44,000 visits spread across them. It's not a big studio; it's the place where I test ideas quickly and ship them.
about.p2: Outside Roblox I work with Godot and GDScript, and for a while now I've been writing my own voxel engine in C++. It's the project I learn the most from: chunks, meshes, lighting, everything a commercial engine hides from you. I also build tools for other developers, like a node editor inside Studio and ready-to-use systems I sell on Gumroad.
about.p3: I record devlogs and demos for YouTube and I'm usually around the studio's Discord. If you're looking for me, I'm almost certainly in Studio.

nodes.title: Node System
nodes.desc: A visual editor of connected nodes that lives inside Roblox Studio. Instead of writing all the logic in Luau, you build it by linking boxes: inputs, conditions, actions. I made it to prototype mechanics without leaving the editor.

mgi.title: Multi Game Inc — PimpoliDev's studio
mgi.lead: Roblox group founded in 2023 by PimpoliDev: this is where the studio's {games} games are published, with {members} members and over {visits} visits in total.
mgi.aboutNote: Who we are and how we make the games.
mgi.aboutP1: Multi Game Inc started in 2023 as the group PimpoliDev publishes his games under. It isn't a big studio and doesn't try to be one: today we're 130 members, between players, people who try the new versions and those who just want to hear about each release first.
mgi.aboutP2: We make short-round games: dodging what falls from the sky, surviving giant celebrities, running across colored blocks. Almost everything is written in Luau inside Roblox Studio, and every game ships first as alpha or beta to see how real people play it before calling it done.
mgi.gamesNote: The {games} games published in the group.
mgi.bannerTitle: Want to keep up with what's new?
mgi.bannerText: Follow the Roblox group. Every release and every update is announced there first.
mgi.contactText: If you want to pitch an idea, try a game before it's out or tell us what you thought, write to us. These are all the places where we are.
mgi.aboutIntro: We are a small Roblox group: we test ideas fast, publish them and let the players decide which one deserves to go on.
mgi.aboutP3: Six games and more than 44,000 visits later we keep the same routine: launch, look at the numbers and improve what works. Everything we publish lives in this group, and the group is open to anyone who wants in.
mgi.goGroup: Go to the group on Roblox
mgi.contactNote: For group matters, Discord is best.
